title: Amid Outcry, Army Delays its Plan to Blow Up Toxic Ammunition in Iowa
summary: The Army had planned to detonate a cache of dangerous explosives on Friday, potentially creating a plume of toxic lead dust stretching for 60 miles. The explosion is now set for Monday.
